balk-grain-and-trucking.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 4 Balk Grain and Trucking locations buying grain in 2 states. Illinois has 3 of them, at Mount Carroll, Savanna and Thomson, and Iowa has 1 at Clinton. The table carries bids for corn and soybeans.

buchheit-agri-division.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 4 Buchheit Agri Division locations, all in Missouri. The elevators sit in Campbell, Dudley, Morehouse and Perryville. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat at each one.

bunge.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 17 Bunge locations across 7 states. Illinois has 5, Montana 4, Indiana 3 and Ohio 2, with 1 each in Alabama, Iowa and Kansas, in towns like Cairo, Griggsville, Chester, Sidney, Delphos and Council Bluffs. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat.
